hook: A protein-ligand language model shows binding-site skills it was never trained for.

readout.label: Dose-response hit rate, de novo compounds

summary: Bonbon, trained only on paired protein-ligand sequences, picks out mechanism of action, binding sites, and covalent versus non-covalent binding without task labels. These abilities jump at the largest of six model sizes, and a wet-lab test on nine targets gave a 61.5% hit rate on new compounds. It is a single-author preprint, and the wet-lab results have not been independently replicated.
title: Emergent Biological Capabilities in a Foundation Model for Molecular Interactions
